name: Carbon Based Auto Category Thumbnails for WooCommerce
author: carbonbasedstudio

sections.description:
WooCommerce shows a placeholder when a product category has no thumbnail. Carbon Based Auto Category Thumbnails for WooCommerce uses a product image from that category instead, and leaves categories that already have a thumbnail alone.

Features

  • Empty categories only – A category with its own thumbnail is not replaced.
  • Product image – Chooses a published product image. Newest by default, or random when that category is refreshed.
  • Child categories – Optional lookup in child categories when the parent has no product image.
  • In stock only – On by default. Skips out-of-stock products even when the shop still lists them. Selling the last copy queues the next in-stock cover.
  • Saved images – The shop shows the saved choice. Publishing or updating a product queues that category and its parents for a background refresh. A separate scheduled job replaces images after the cache period, in small batches. A page view does not rebuild every category.
  • Classic grids, shortcode, and blocks – Category archives, the shop page, the product categories shortcode, and the Product Categories block.
  • Excluded images – Comma-separated Media Library IDs that are never chosen.
  • Refresh and test – Refresh saved images from the settings screen, or test one category ID.

Requires WooCommerce. Settings are under Carbon Based > Auto Category Thumbnails.

Who is this for?

  • Stores with many product categories and no time to upload a thumbnail for each one.
  • Shops that want a real product picture instead of the WooCommerce placeholder.
  • Sites that already set some category images by hand and want the rest filled in.

User guide

Setup and settings are covered in the Auto Category Thumbnails user guide.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install this plugin from the WordPress plugins directory, or upload the carbon-based-auto-category-thumbnails-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Carbon Based Auto Category Thumbnails for WooCommerce.
  4. Open Carbon Based > Auto Category Thumbnails. It is on by default. Save if you change a setting.
